name: FIToFIPaymentCancellationRequest
label: FI to FI Payment Cancellation Request
summary: Asks a downstream agent to stop or recall a payment. A request, not an instruction — the receiving agent can and often will refuse.
whenUsed: Fraud, duplication, or a customer-requested recall. Sent as far down the chain as needed, each agent relaying it onward. The answer comes back as a camt.029, and if the recall succeeds the money returns as a pacs.004. The core of the SWIFT gpi stop-and-recall service.
gotchas: Nothing here compels anyone. Once funds are credited to a beneficiary, the creditor agent generally needs the beneficiary's consent to return them, so a cancellation request is best-efforts. Telling a customer their payment 'has been cancelled' on the strength of having sent this message is a mis-statement.

Speed is everything and the window is short. Before settlement, cancellation usually works; after credit to the beneficiary it usually does not. Any manual step in your recall process is the reason recalls fail.
Three separate messages are involved and they are routinely confused: camt.056 asks, camt.029 answers, pacs.004 moves the money back. A camt.029 saying CNCL is not funds received.

fields.name: Assignment
fields.note: Who is asking whom. Unusually, this replaces the usual Group Header — cancellation and investigation messages are modelled as a case assigned from one party to another.

fields.name: Assignee
fields.note: The agent being asked to act.

fields.name: Creation Date Time
fields.note: Timestamped because the elapsed time since the original payment determines whether recall is even possible.

fields.name: Case
fields.note: The investigation case this belongs to, carried through every related message so the whole exchange can be followed.

fields.name: Creator
fields.note: Who opened the case. Stays fixed even as the case is relayed between agents.

fields.name: Underlying
fields.note: What is to be cancelled — a whole original group, or named transactions within it.

fields.name: Original Group Information And Cancellation
fields.note: Use to cancel an entire original message.

fields.name: Cancellation Identification
fields.note: Your reference for this specific cancellation request.

fields.name: Original UETR
fields.note: The identifier that actually finds the payment several hops downstream. Without it, each agent has to search by amount and name.

fields.name: Cancellation Reason Information
fields.note: Why. Drives how urgently the receiving agent treats it — FRAD gets escalated, CUST is queued.

fields.name: Originator
fields.note: Who wants the cancellation: the debtor, the debtor agent, or an authority.

fields.name: Additional Information
fields.note: Free text supporting the request. For fraud cases this is where the evidence summary goes, and a thin one gets the request refused.

fields.name: Original Transaction Reference
fields.note: Copy of the original payment, so the assignee can identify it even with imperfect references.
